name: Jace Stratton
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE static full-body 2D game sprite of JACE STRATTON from GEARS OF WAR 3, using the attached Gears 3 promotional portrait as the visual identity and costume reference. Match his face, skin tone, tightly braided cornrows swept back, small mustache and chin facial hair, characteristic pale silver-grey COG breastplate with two dark circular chest components and split central vertical panel, segmented dark shoulder armor, rolled dark shirt sleeves exposing his forearms, white-grey gloves, circular belt buckle and utility gear. Preserve the original character and outfit rather than redesigning him. Complete his legs with the standard dark Gears 3 military trousers, matching knee plates and heavy dark COG boots; avoid added colors or ornaments. Full-body, standing in a neutral ready pose with both hands empty, turned three-quarter side view facing RIGHT. Realistic muscular Gears proportions, detailed hand-painted 2D UHD asset with worn metal texture and fabric. Remove all promotional background, emblem and title: only Jace against real alpha transparency. No other figures, no weapon, no scene, no text, no animation. Entire figure head-to-sole visible, generous transparent margin on all sides.

sources.scope: Portrait Gears 3, visage et haut du corps. Bas du corps non fourni.

notes: Aucun PNG produit. Maintenu parmi les manquants, sans contournement du refus.
